marketing_description: The Milwaukee 2545-20 Cordless Jig Saw is a tool from the M18 Series, powered by an 18 V M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 battery. It features a metal housing with a black finish, a trigger switch, and a comfort grip handle made of rubber with a black finish. The tool includes a brushless motor and is compatible with M18 REDLITHIUM batteries.
